activities.title: Learn & Build Sessions
activities.body:
First half: presentation & discussion.
Second half: hands-on build related to the first half.
No need to attend every time.

activities.title: Build Hour
activities.body: Build on any theme you like — yours or a suggested one. Ask questions, trade ideas, then demo the outputs to each other.

activities.title: “Tips Exchange” Pair
steps: Get paired with one member, usually from another region.
Each share one tip — a few lines or a screenshot is fine.
Try your partner’s tip, then reply.

activities.title: Questions answered in chat
activities.body: Ask in the *#03_Ask for help* channel, whenever you have questions or problem.

activities.title: Casual Interaction Events
activities.body: Welcome events for new members, and casual events in between.
